Check that K remains near-invariant across scales and species.

parameters.text: Real brain tissues are known to change their growth rates in response to stress (20), and other mechanisms lead to relaxation of elastic stresses over time.

key: advisory:{"text": "Real brain tissues are known to change their growth rates in response to stress (20), and other mechanisms lead to relaxation of elastic stresses over time."}
statement: The mechanical model uses simplified geometries and material properties; real tissues may have stress-dependent growth and stress relaxation.

statement: The scaling law is empirical and does not specify the actual cortical shape beyond a constraint binding three morphometric parameters.
The pial surface file (?h.pial) for the subject, produced by the recon-all -all stream.
MATLAB with Image Processing Toolbox and $FREESURFER_HOME/matlab in the MATLAB path.
MATLAB and its Image Processing Toolbox must be installed and accessible.
The MATLAB path must include $FREESURFER_HOME/matlab, set up in ~/matlab/startup.m.
Check for topological defects of the pial surface using mris_euler_number, as defects cause mris_compute_lgi to crash.
If mris_compute_lgi crashes due to topological defects, simply relaunching it is usually sufficient to overcome the issue.
T1-weighted MR scan of a macaque brain as the primary input.
The NMT v2 is the current version of the template, with symmetric and asymmetric variants and multiple resolutions.

parameters.text: This value can be determined empirically such that the intensities for gray matter and white matter appear mostly uniform across the brain.

statement: The N3 spline distance should be empirically determined to ensure uniform gray and white matter intensities.

parameters.text: In the rare case when registration fails, a custom brain mask in native space can be supplied.

statement: The pipeline may require manual intervention for custom brain masks in rare registration failures.
T1 weighted images are expected with the _T1w BIDS extension.
The -soft parameter must be either SPM or ANTS, with SPM requiring a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d not available by default.
The -test option can be used to check if the full pipeline is coherent, generating only graph.dot and graph.png.
The -prep option performs only data preparation, without brain extraction and segmentation.
The _4animal option uses bet4animal (FSL) for brain extraction, for faster computation; by default atlas_brex is used.

statement: The marmoT2 species option can be used for segmenting from the T2w image; by default, T1w is used for marmo.

One or more co-registered MRI volumes in Nifti (.nii/.nii.gz) or FreeSurfer (.mgz) format.
All input volumes must be co-registered with each other and have the same image grid size and voxel dimensions.
